content.title: Where to watch Phillies vs. Diamondbacks MLB game tonight on free streams, TV
content.text: Philadelphia Phillies' Bryce Harper, right, is congratulated by J.T. Realmuto (10) after scoring on a sacrifice fly hit by Brandon Marsh during the seventh inning of a baseball game against the San Francisco Giants in San Francisco, Monday, April 6, 2026. (AP Photo/Jed Jacobsohn)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe Philadelphia Phillies are back at Citizens Bank Park on Friday night to kick off a key early nine-game home stand with a series against the Arizona Diamondbacks. The game is scheduled to start at 6:40 p.m. ET with TV coverage on ESPN Unlimited and streaming on-demand.MLB on ESPN Unlimited: Major League Baseball, MLB Network and MLB.tv now reside in ESPN Unlimited’s interface. This game will stream on ESPN Unlimited, which is available as a standalone product ($29.99/month) and features all ESPN channels and ESPN+ access. ESPN Unlimited is also available through streaming services FuboTV (free trial) and DirecTV (free trial).Access to MLB.tv requires an additional fee, either annually for $134.99 (ESPN Unlimited subscribers) or $149.99 (non-subscribers) or monthly for $29.99. The monthly plan comes with one free month of ESPN Unlimited.How to watch Phillies vs. Diamondbacks on TV and stream without cable:When: Friday, April 10 at 6:40 p.m. ETWhere: Citizen Bank Park, Philadelphia, Pa.TV channel: ESPN UnlimitedStreaming on: FuboTV (free trial) | DirecTV (free trial) | ESPN Unlimited ($29.99/mo.)Phillies vs. Diamondbacks: The matchupThe Phillies went 3-3 on a Western road swing through Colorado and San Francisco, but suffered three losses in their final four games of the trip to miss a sweep of the Rockies and lose two of three to the Giants in San Francisco. Meanwhile, the Diamondbacks are 7-6 and trending in the right direction after winning four of their past five games spanning series against the New York Mets and Atlanta Braves. With a 3.89 staff ERA, pitching has been a staple in the Diamondbacks’ solid start, with Friday starter Michael Soroka (2-0, 0.90 ERA) leading the way with two wins in two starts, allowing one combined run against strong foes in the Braves and Detroit Tigers. The Phillies will counter with promising lefty Jesus Luzardo (1-1, 4.97 ERA), who comes off a masterful performance against the Rockies in Colorado, allowing five hits and one run with 11 strikeouts and no walks over 6.2 innings to pick up his first win. Phillies vs. Diamondbacks: Know your live streamsFuboTV (free trial): FuboTV offers the most extensive package of live sports with rates competitive with DirecTV. The FuboTV Pro ($48.99 first month), Elite ($53.99) and Deluxe ($73.99) all come with first-month discounts. Fubo streaming plans include access to ESPN Unlimited.DirecTV (free trial): DirecTV offers a 5-day free trial and a total of $30 off over the first three full months for the Choice Package, which includes 125-plus channels and access to ESPN Unlimited, a $29.99 standalone value featuring all ESPN channels and ESPN+.ESPN Unlimited ($29.99 bundle): ESPN has a new, standalone package that includes ABC broadcasts, all of ESPN’s sports channels, and access to ESPN+. For a limited time, ESPN can be bundled with Disney Plus and Hulu for $29.99 per month. This package is included free in select FuboTV and DirecTV plans, along with other TV providers.
